meta.name: adversarial-reviewer
meta.description: Adversarial code review that breaks the self-review monoculture. Use when you want a genuinely critical review of recent changes, before merging a PR, or when you suspect Claude is being too agreeable about code quality. Forces perspective shifts through hostile reviewer personas that catch blind spots the author's mental model shares with the reviewer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在合并前获得真正挑剔的代码审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望代码审查能发现盲点，避免自我审查的盲区
copy.tagline_en: Get genuinely critical code reviews before merging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want code reviews that catch blind spots and avoid self-review bias

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演三个挑剔的审查者（破坏者、新人、安全审计员），每个都必须找出至少一个代码问题，并按严重程度分级给出合并建议（阻止/有顾虑/干净）。
howto.when: 当你输入 /adversarial-review 命令，或要求审查代码变更、合并请求时触发。

say.text: 请用 adversarial-review 审查我最近的代码改动。
say.note: Claude 会运行三个审查者角色并输出报告。

say.text: 审查 main 分支和当前分支的差异。

howto.what_en: Claude adopts three adversarial personas (Saboteur, New Hire, Security Auditor), each must find at least one issue. Findings are severity-ranked and a verdict (BLOCK/CONCERNS/CLEAN) is given.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you use the /adversarial-review command or ask for a code review of recent changes or a pull request.

say_en.text: Run an adversarial review on my recent code changes.
say_en.note: Claude runs three personas and outputs a report.

say_en.text: Review the diff between main and my branch.
